purpose: Original conceptual illustration for the ZUKAN photo-first biosecurity guide, suitable for children and accompanying adults.
description: An anonymous child and accompanying adult photograph a tree from a broad safe level park path. Neither person touches the tree or an insect. Warm gouache and paper texture, ivory, forest green, sage, yellow and restrained orange.
visualQA: Root inspected the generated illustration at full returned resolution: child and adult remain on the path, one phone, no labels, logos, watermarks, species identification claims or recognizable person.
usageNote: Conceptual illustration, not a photograph, evidence of a real sighting, geographic map, official mascot or species identification diagram.
alt: 安全な小道から、子どもと大人が一緒に木の様子を写真に残すイラスト
packaging: Original retained; WebP derivative uses Sharp resizing/encoding only, with no creative alteration.

sourceGeneration.retention: Original generation retained separately; this repository deploys the WebP derivative.
